title: VTC Directory — Images — Upload — payload
description: A member, or a directory administrator, hands the community an image for a directory card — an avatar or an `image` field. The community re-encodes it and answers the reference a card holds. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

mediaType.description: The media type of `data` as sent. The community may store another: it re-encodes.

data.description: The image, base64url without padding (RFC 4648 §5). At most 262144 bytes decoded.

Response.title: VTC Directory — Images — Upload — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/directory/images/upload/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/directory/images/upload/0.1#response.

image.description: The stored, re-encoded image, without `url` or `urlExpiresAt`. A card holds this as the field's value.

expiresAt.description: When the community erases the image if no card holds it by then.
